name: ai_step
description: Do ONE act in the game as the character, wait until the game has settled, and read what changed. Answers one line of JSON: ok, mode, did, why_not, hint, now. `now` holds only what changed since your last call: where, fight, can, party, waiting, near, heard, events, notes (and in mode open: rolls, scenes, route). If `now.waiting` is not empty, answer it first, exactly as its line says. When ok is false nothing was done: read why_not and make the call that hint gives.

do.description: The act. go: walk to target. use: walk up and use target (door, lever, ladder, pod). talk: walk up and talk to target. loot: walk up and open target (a body, a chest). jump: jump to target. cast: use the action `spell` at target. attack: weapon attack at target. end: end the turn. select: take control of party member `who`. answer: choose answer number `n` of what waits. continue: go on in a dialogue. roll: throw the dice of a roll window. take: take everything from the open loot window. close: close the window that waits. wait: do nothing until the game has settled. plan: do the act that now.route names (mode open). cheat_cast: cast `spell` at target by script. cheat_teleport: put the character at target. The two cheats are used only when the owner says so.

target.description: What the act is done to: a handle from now.near (like #1a2b3c), a name, or a point as text "x,y,z".

spell.description: For cast: the action's name as now.can lists it (like Projectile_FireBolt).

n.description: For answer: the number of the answer, as now.waiting numbers them.

who.description: The party member who acts, by name. Left out: in a fight the member whose turn is open, else the character you control.

say.description: A short first-person line shown over the character's head before the act (60 characters at most).

think.description: One line of what the character thinks. Kept in the run's record only.

note.description: A note to yourself kept with this place, across reloads: you are shown it again when you come back here.

name: ai_look
description: Read the whole situation again, or one part of it, when you are lost. Changes nothing in the game. Answers one line of JSON: ok, mode, did, why_not, hint, now.

part.description: all (default): every key of now as it is at this moment. A key of now: only it. things: every object around, items included. actions: what the acting character can do. notes: your notes of this level. prompt: the owner's text for you, again. rolls, scenes, route, plan (every step of the route): mode open only.

detail.description: brief (default): short lists. full: long lists and whole texts.

name: ai_scene
description: The owner's director commands: run a named call of a staged scene, or read a scene's state. Use it only when the owner says so. Answers one line of JSON: ok, mode, did, why_not, hint, now.

name.description: The scene's name as now.scenes shows it. Left out: every scene with its state and calls.

call.description: The call of that scene to run (like go or reply). Left out: the scene's state and its calls.

name: ai_session
description: Call this first. It starts the session and answers the owner's own text for you as `prompt` (who you are, what is wanted, how to talk) and the whole situation as `now`. With no arguments it reads the session again and changes nothing. Answers one line of JSON: ok, mode, did, why_not, hint, prompt, now.

mode.description: blind: you are told only what a player at the screen could know. open: everything the bridge can read, with scenes and a route. Left out: the mode stays as it is.

prompt.description: The owner's own text for the model, given as text.

prompt_file.description: The same, given as the path of a plain text file on the machine that runs the game.

plan.description: Mode open only: the name of a route plan to follow (like prologue), or off.

step.description: Mode open only: the number of the plan's step to stand on.
